title: PHP Conference China 2020
content:
The 8th PHP conference china will be held in Shanghai, China on October 17-18, 2020. This event filled with high quality, technical sessions about PHP Core, PHP High Performance, PHP Engineering, AI and Blockchain more. Don’t miss out on 2-great days sessions, delicious food, fantastic shows, and countless networking opportunities to engage with speakers and delegates. Go to for tickets and more information.

www.phpconchina.com
